checkpoint_selection: lowest validation MAE within each preselected run; no test ranking
release_scope: historical daylight-compressed protocol; opt-in experimental inference; not energy-v3 unified main result
tolerance_note: CPU/GPU float32 inference is numerically close but not bitwise identical for long horizons. All reported max deltas are retained; acceptance is norm atol=1e-3/rtol=1e-4 and absolute error <=0.1% nominal Cap. This tolerance validates deployment numerical equivalence, not metric reproduction or training correctness.
